sense: one space in a building, with walls

pins.definition: A separate space inside a building, especially a bedroom or a hotel room.
A part of a building enclosed by walls, a floor, and a ceiling, especially in a home or hotel.
A separate part of the inside of a building, enclosed by walls, a floor, and a ceiling.

situation: A tenant inspecting a tidy, newly painted apartment interior bounded by four clear walls, a floor, and a ceiling.
subject: the enclosed space
brief: A clean cross-section of a domestic space shows four distinct walls, a polished wooden floor, and a flat ceiling enclosing a single furnished room. A small wooden table and a chair sit in the center, perfectly contained within the distinct boundaries of the room.
prompt: A clean cross-section of a domestic space shows four distinct walls, a polished wooden floor, and a flat ceiling enclosing a single furnished room. A small wooden table and a chair sit in the center, perfectly contained within the distinct boundaries of the room. layered cut paper filling the whole frame, real depth between the layers, crisp cast shadows, visibly fibrous card and translucent tissue, raking side light. Never a box, a shadow-box or a picture frame around the scene — the paper IS the world, not an object sitting inside one. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
